seo.title: SOON Izakaya JLT | Japanese Izakaya, Sushi & Cocktails at Armada Tower 2
seo.description: SOON Izakaya, Armada Tower 2, Cluster P, JLT: Tokyo-style izakaya with wagyu katsu sando, prawn gyoza, lobster maki and sushi, signature cocktails, DJs and a terrace. Open 3 PM to 1 AM. 4.7 from 1,186 reviews.

hero.lede: A Tokyo-raised izakaya with wagyu katsu sando, prawn gyoza, lobster maki and sushi, signature cocktails, DJs on weekends and a terrace facing the towers. Open daily from 3 PM to 1 AM.
